scientific_integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md; finite independent MST enumeration and quadrature in CHECK.py. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The quantitative result uses two independent uniform eccentric-anomaly antipodal pairs from a fixed planar ellipse; it is not arclength sampling nor a four-independent-point model. Ties are excluded. The general oval characterization assumes central symmetry and C1 strict convexity. Historical priority and independent proof validation remain outstanding.
title: Circle rigidity and a sharp anisotropy threshold for Euclidean spanning trees of antipodal ellipse quadruples
